title: Construct all-mean J1 adapted support with an explicit reserve
statement: For r=k=1, upper-triangular A=[[alpha,beta],[0,delta]],L=diag(2,-4), every symmetric H satisfies J1(A+LH)>=J1(A)+DJ1(A):LH+Lambda(A)det(LH), strictly for H!=0, with Lambda=(alpha^2-beta^2-delta^2+7alpha delta)/2. For ANY A choose constant LEFT R with R^T A upper triangular and use L_A=R L; invariant Lambda=(|A1|^2-|A2|^2+7det A)/2. First-column-zero means allow any R. The full affine Schur proof gives J(X)-c^T Q^-1 c/4>=J(X)/5263589376. Integrated all-amplitude periodic W2,4/compact scalar inequality is strict for nonzero Hessian. This theorem is included in the later all-r range; retain its explicit numerical reserve without duplicate discovery credit. No right/source rotation, common L for all means or arbitrary vector perturbation.
